fields.description: The place is the community’s most important and concentrates resources, reputation, and local conflict.
The place influences the whole country and benefits from exceptional political protection.
The place is unique on the continent and attracts experts, pilgrims, spies, and foreign powers.
Official access is forbidden during an inquiry, contamination, or crisis that authorities minimize.
Part of the place is inaccessible while workers, scaffolding, and old plans create new routes.
